messages:
Rae: Heads-up — Zenith Labs wants a short hosted PoC burst next Fri 13:30-13:50 PT. They like a scoped API key + temporary quota lift and IP allowlist for load testing (approx 140 clients, ~9 rps). Org: org-zenith-21. Can we do that?
Omar: Quick sizing — what model and avg tokens per request? Need tokens/min to size the quota.
Rae: Using redwood-1.3-large on /v1/generate. Avg ~340 tokens end-to-end. Ballpark = 140 * 9 * 340 = ~428k tokens/min. Asking for 550k tokens/min to be safe over a 20m window.
Sylvie: That be ~7.2k tokens/sec. We can reserve on us-west-2 hosted pool; recommend token_quota_per_minute=550000, concurrent limit=160, valid_window=2026-10-09T20:30:00Z/2026-10-09T20:50:00Z. Also suggest fallback routing to a quantized variant to avoid hard failures.
Ken: From security: scoped key only, IP allowlist mandatory, mask prompt_text in logs, set retention 72h, and disable long-term export for the key. Need named contact for DSR.
Rae: Contact is amir@zenith.ai. I prefer automatic graceful fallback to a smaller model if saturation occurs rather than 429s. Also curious about cost estimate for the 20m window — any rough numbers?
Omar: Cost rough calc: 550k tokens/min * 20 min = 11M tokens. At hosted rates that be approx X credits — I confirm pricing in the PoC quote but ballpark 11M tokens ~ moderate spend. We can also apply a billing cap on the scoped key if you want.
Sylvie: I create the scoped key with routing_policy.fallback_model=redwood-1.3-small and response_header=X-RW-Fallback. Sample admin call I run after IPs:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"org_id":"org-zenith-21","name":"zenith-poc-burst","scopes":["gen:invoke"],"token_quota_per_minute":"550000","concurrent_request_limit":"160","valid_window":"2026-10-09T20:30:00Z/2026-10-09T20:50:00Z","routing_policy":{"fallback_model":"redwood-1.3-small","response_header":"X-RW-Fallback"}}'\
```
infra-bot: ACTION: reserved capacity on pool us-west-2 for tag "zenith-poc-burst"  ticket INF-7018  reserved 650 rps-equivalent.
Ken: I also like retention set to 72h and logs masked for prompt_text, user_email. Confirm IP ranges and I sign off.
Rae: IP ranges DM. Please share the scoped key securely once created and monitor for >0.8% 5xx or median latency >500ms during the window.
Sylvie: Will do — I enable an observability alert and auto-throttle the key if cross-customer impact is detected. I create the key after IPs land and post the key id here.
Rae: Thanks team — closing loop after the test and will post results and any anomalies.
